lateral_flank_blob_constellation.centroid_triangulation: A primary horizontal sequence of four high-luminance circular clusters is located along the ventral edge of the visible flank, with a secondary row of approximately five smaller, lower-intensity spots distributed between the ventral row and the longitudinal ridge.

carinae_gradient_vectors.ridge_trajectory: A singular, prominent horizontal linear feature is visible running parallel to the longitudinal axis just ventral to the dorsal fin insertion, defined by a distinct pixel intensity gradient with light on the superior edge and shadow on the inferior edge.

acquired_anomalies_or_scars: The posterior margin of the dorsal fin exhibits three distinct V-shaped notches or serrations, indicating localized tissue loss on the lower third of the trailing edge.
